purpose: Define how Throne should treat Mechanicus readiness rollup before Crown closure.
crown_rules: A readiness rollup may improve visibility but does not assemble the organ.
Mechanicus remains NOT_ASSEMBLED until launcher, personal validators, Custodes validators, Throne validators, red layer and blue layer have current proof.
Core v1 must not depend on local model membrane; script-first evidence remains primary.
Throne may use this rollup as input to gap maps, not as a Crown verdict.
